items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Hershey Kay latched onto a musical and I started doing that. So then we began eating a little regularly

ctx.x: I came back here and there was nothing. Ray Sheiner, the oboist, got me onto a couple of commercials, but I couldn't live on what I was getting.
Hershey Kay latched onto a musical and I started doing that. So then we began eating a little regularly and the kids went to school and we got all that taken care of.
That's about where it's been ever since.
